mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT smb.id as materialBatchId, smb.material_id, COALESCE(br.reservation_sum, '0') as remainingQuantity, bo.operation_sum as operateQuantity, br.unit_id, smb.material_batch_no, smb.hydration, smb.no_hydration_content, smb.supplier, smb.producer, smb.expired_date, smb.factory_batch_no, smb.original_batch_no, smb.report_no, smb.licence_no, bo.min_id FROM bm_storage_material_batch smb LEFT JOIN (SELECT sm.storage_material_batch_id, SUM(CASE WHEN rcm.cancel_reserve = 0 THEN rcm.quantity WHEN rcm.cancel_reserve = 1 THEN CONCAT('-', rcm.quantity) ELSE '0' END) as operation_sum, MIN(rcm.id) as min_id FROM bm_reserve_component_material rcm JOIN bm_storage_material sm ON rcm.storage_material_id = sm.id WHERE rcm.instance_id = #{instanceId} GROUP BY sm.storage_material_batch_id) bo ON smb.id = bo.storage_material_batch_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sm.storage_material_batch_id, SUM(sm.reserve_quantity) as reservation_sum, sm.unit_id FROM bm_storage_material_reserve smr JOIN bm_storage_material sm ON smr.storage_material_id = sm.id WHERE smr.is_deleted = 0 AND smr.batch_id = #{productPlanId} AND (sm.sign_status is null or sm.sign_status = 1) GROUP BY sm.storage_material_batch_id) br ON smb.id = br.storage_material_batch_id WHERE (bo.operation_sum IS NOT NULL OR br.reservation_sum IS NOT NULL);
